title: LumoraFirestoreSchema
description: Firestore database blueprint schema for Lumora privacy-first face and skin progress journal

users.description: Root document for user profile, consents, retention mode, and entitlement

profile.description: User profile with display name, optional birth year, skin type, concerns, reference range preference

consent.description: Versioned granular consents: onDevice, cloudAI, photoSync, analytics

retention.description: Photo retention settings (mode: DONT_KEEP, KEEP_ON_DEVICE, BACKUP_30, etc.)

entitlement.description: Subscription tier, source, expiry, and server-side verification status

deletionRequested.description: Resumable flag set when account deletion is initiated

scans.description: Individual scan record with metadata, quality scores, metrics, and indices

plan.description: Current active plan and habits intentions

replyReports.description: User reports on AI coach responses for safety compliance

usage.description: Daily usage counters for soft rate-limiting (aiSkin, coachMsgs)
